name: Objectives
description: The live hierarchy of intents and goals across requests. A new request is placed under the objective it serves, and a goal rolls up to its parent. Which milestones matter most to the person is asked of Prioritization.
purpose: Let the AI keep working toward a goal over many requests and know which objective a request serves.
approach: Read each objective's done-standard (its criteria), roll progress up from goals to their parents, and place a request under the live objective whose own words it shares most.
out_of_scope: Turning a request into a metric (Metric Translation does that) nudging the Planner (Guidance does that) and deciding which milestones matter most to the person (Prioritization does that).
milestones: 1. An objective persists and progress is checked against its done-standard (metric-live-objectives).
measures_of_success: An objective persists and progress is checked against its done-standard.
inputs: A person and the objectives their system recorded (each with an id, a title, a parent, the criteria that say it is done and whether each is met); for a placement, also the request.
outputs: The hierarchy in order, each objective with its depth, state (not started, in progress or met) and progress rolled up from its criteria and children; or, for a request, the live objective it serves with its path from the top, or none.
effects: Reads and writes nothing itself: the arms are pure functions of the objectives they are given, and the system keeps the store.
usage_notes: `hubofhubs.run("live-objectives", {"objectives": [...]})` returns the hierarchy with each objective's state and progress; the `place` call puts a request under the objective it serves. In a person's words it is asked for as: keep track of my goals and milestones over weeks, work that runs for days and must survive restarts, where a long-running goal stands; durable job and workflow engines compete here.
